test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Jaya can do a certain piece of work in 30 days. Jaya and Sushma can together do the same work in 21 days, and Jaya, Sushma and Hina can do the same work together in 14 days. In how many days can Jaya and Hina do the same work together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(30, 21, 14) = 210 units.

Efficiency: Jaya = 7, Jaya + Sushma = 10, Jaya + Sushma + Hina = 15.

Efficiency of Hina = (Jaya + Sushma + Hina) − (Jaya + Sushma) = 15 − 10 = 5 units/day.

Combined efficiency of Jaya and Hina = 7 + 5 = 12 units/day.

Time taken by Jaya and Hina = 210 ÷ 12 = 35/2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 35/2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Jaya = 30 days

Time taken by Jaya and Sushma = 21 days

Time taken by Jaya, Sushma, and Hina = 14 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Jaya
 30
 210
 210 ÷ 30 = 7
 
 

 Jaya + Sushma
 21
 210 ÷ 21 = 10
 
 

 Jaya + Sushma + Hina
 14
 210 ÷ 14 = 15
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Jaya = 7 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Jaya + Sushma = 10 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Jaya + Sushma + Hina = 15 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Hina = Efficiency of (Jaya + Sushma + Hina) − Efficiency of (Jaya + Sushma)

⇒ Efficiency of Hina = 15 − 10 = 5 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of Jaya and Hina = Efficiency of Jaya + Efficiency of Hina

⇒ Combined efficiency of Jaya and Hina = 7 + 5 = 12 units/day

⇒ Time taken by Jaya and Hina = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken by Jaya and Hina = 210 ÷ 12 = 35/2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 35/2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Similar to Time & Work, filling pipes have positive efficiency while emptying pipes have negative efficiency. The total capacity of the tank acts as the Total Work.

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the direct ratio of the total work done by individuals. If they work together for the same number of days, wages are directly proportional to their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, find the work done in one complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and divide the total work by this cycle's work to determine the number of complete cycles.
